Class OrderTile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.board.OrderTile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class OrderTile extends Object implements Serializable
Turn-order tile picked by each player at the start of a round. The tile determines the player's position in the turn sequence and applies a food / victory-points modifier (the last tile in each player-count layout carries a penalty). The isFree flag tracks whether the tile is still available to pick.
